name: Four Seasons Cabo San Lucas @ Cabo del Sol
insider_take: Perched on the dramatic coastline where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, this desert oasis combines Four Seasons luxury with Baja California's rugged natural beauty.
whats_special: Located on the exclusive Cabo del Sol golf course, this resort sits at Land's End - one of only three places on Earth where two seas meet. The property features the only swimmable beach in the Cabo San Lucas hotel zone and offers unobstructed views of the iconic El Arco rock formation. The resort's Jack Nicklaus-designed Ocean Golf Course is consistently ranked among Mexico's top courses.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant during whale watching season (December-April) when gray whales migrate through these waters - you might spot them from your table.
dont_miss: Take the resort's complimentary boat shuttle to downtown Cabo San Lucas marina, snorkel at Chileno Beach (10 minutes away), and experience the dramatic sunrise over the Sea of Cortez from your private terrace - a view you can only get from this side of the peninsula.
pros: World-class Four Seasons service and luxury amenities
Prime beachfront location on the Sea of Cortez
Championship Jack Nicklaus golf course on-site
Multiple fine dining restaurants and premium spa facilities
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Located outside downtown Cabo San Lucas
